title: S&P Global Flash US PMI (Nov 2026) — 09:45 ET, the date this survey's information actually lands
source: EST: read verbatim off S&P Global's own calendar listing, pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Release/ReleaseDates?language=en, fetched direct twice — 2026-10-26 by the proposing lane and again 2026-11-08 by this event's initial research (HTTP 200, 27,453 bytes, browser User-Agent): 'November 23 ... 14:45 UTC S&P Global Flash US PMI'. 14:45 UTC is 09:45 EST (US clocks changed 2026-11-01). notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-11-08), reading the single prior proposal (proposals/sp-global-flash-us-pmi-2026-11-23.from-sp-global-manufacturing-pmi-2026-11-02.json) as input; the proposal is now inert.
